{{Top|leg}}
'''Anesthetics''' were a common medicine that were used to reduce a patient's discomfort.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> They were included as standard in [[Chiewab Amalgamated Pharmaceuticals Company]]'s [[ECM-598 Medical Backpack]].

[[MD-2 medical droid]]s were programmed to administer anesthetics to patients and monitor their vital functions during surgery.<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>
